question: What is the generic name given to members of the cat family?
solution:
The correct option is __**Feline**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Feline or Felidae** is a family of mammals in the order** Carnivora**, colloquially referred to as cats.
 
• Wild cats occur in **Africa, Europe, Asia and the Americas**.
 
• **The Lion, Tiger, Jaguar, Cheetah, Panther etc. **are wild cats.
 
• These are predators by nature and can be harmful if domesticated.
 
• All the members of cat family are** mammals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Canine**

 
 
• **​Canine** is also called** Canid**.
 
• Any of 36 living species of **foxes, wolves, jackals, and other members of the dog family.**
 
• **The dog** was the first species to be domesticated, by hunter-gatherers.
 
 
 
• **Bovine**
 
 
• ​Bovines is a diverse group of 10 genera of medium to large-sized ungulates.
 
• It includes** cattle, bison, African buffalo, water buffalos**, and the **four-horned and spiral-horned antelopes.**
 
• The largest extant bovine is the** gaur**.
 
 
 
• **Caprine**
 
 
• The subfamily** Caprinae**, is part of the ruminant family **Bovidae**, and consists of mostly medium-sized bovids.
 
• A member of this subfamily is called a **Caprine**, or, more informally, a goat-antelope.
 
• Within this tribe, a prominent clade includes sheep and goats.
